conditions.name: HEAD-SHIFT
conditions.what: 3 cm sideways; 5 cm back; slouch 2 cm (three runs, pooled)

conditions.name: HEAD-ROTATE
conditions.what: 5 degrees yaw; 5 degrees pitch (two runs, pooled)

conditions.name: LATER
conditions.what: five minutes on, after a slow 2 cm drift

primaryDefinition: S_still = median over seeds of the fixation-level euclidean RMS error (CSS px) in SYNTH-3D STILL at 0.5 px iris noise; S_move = the same for the mean of HEAD-SHIFT and HEAD-ROTATE
